concepts.learning_objective: Recognise a differential equation and distinguish an ordinary differential equation from a partial one.
Find the order of a differential equation from its highest order derivative.
Find the degree of a differential equation when it is a polynomial in its derivatives, and recognise when it is not defined.
Verify by substitution that a given function is a solution of a differential equation.
Distinguish general and particular solutions and relate the number of arbitrary constants to the order.
Identify and solve first order, first degree equations whose variables can be separated.
Use a given condition or point on a curve to find a particular solution.
Model continuous growth with dP/dt = kP and interpret its solution.
Test whether a function of x and y is homogeneous and find its degree.
Solve a homogeneous differential equation using the substitution y = vx.
Write a first order linear equation in standard form and find its integrating factor.
Solve a first order linear differential equation using its integrating factor.
